positions.title: Undergraduate Research, Superconductor Interfaces
positions.description:
The Magnetism and Superconductivity Group is focused on studying phenomena in superconductors and epitaxial oxide interfaces. The lab also uses NNRFM to study spin dynamics in micro samples. 

Thesis focused on oxide interfaces, examining different materials that would allow for transmission of electricity with little to nil electrical resistance. Research results analyzed using Python.
